insight: Per-position multi-decode is the bottleneck. Fewer positions = fewer decodes = exponential throughput gain. Accept_rate scales UP not down because each verify cycle accepts ~1 draft proportionally; fewer-position cycles = same accepted/proposed ratio. Recommended production config: dtn=2 steps=1.
